target.statement: Locked balanced LinearSVC (word unigram-bigram TF-IDF, C=0.5) achieves Macro-F1 = 0.6578 on the held-out CrisisBench Test split
target.dataset: CrisisBench v1.0 English humanitarian task (87,455 records; 11 labels)

compute.basis: TF-IDF + LinearSVC on ~70k short texts fits in seconds on CPU (paper reports ~2s vectorisation, ~2s fitting); main cost is downloading CrisisBench and writing the preprocessing/vectoriser code, which is fully specified in the text.

blockers: No code released; pipeline must be re-implemented from the paper's prose description
Exact preprocessing/vectoriser details must be matched to hit the reported number
CrisisBench download location not linked in the paper (must be found independently)
title: Lightweight Machine Learning for Classifying Disaster-Related Social Media Posts
